item.tib: phyi nang gsang ba'i gzungs 'dus bklag thabs gsal byed 'phrul sgron
item.note: this is a pronunciation guide for words used in gzungs. the colophon is difficult to read, but it seems to say that on the behest of 'gru-btsun skal-bzang ye-shes, it was prepared by sga-btsun u-ma and sam-kha-dra rad-na si-ti khin-tsa, without forgetting the oral instruction of lama kun-dga' rang-grol. it was composed in the sixteenth rab byung, the fire horse year (i.e. 1930).
